title: Checkout database connection pool exhausted
description: Customers on the checkout page are seeing intermittent 'unable to complete order' errors. Application logs show the checkout service repeatedly failing to acquire a connection from the primary database pool during a traffic spike.
logs: 2026-08-24T09:12:01Z ERROR checkout-service: Database connection pool exhausted, unable to acquire connection after 30000ms
2026-08-24T09:12:04Z WARN  checkout-service: Connection wait queue depth = 214, exceeds threshold of 50
2026-08-24T09:12:07Z ERROR checkout-service: Database connection pool exhausted, unable to acquire connection after 30000ms
2026-08-24T09:12:15Z ERROR checkout-db: FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections
2026-08-24T09:13:02Z ERROR checkout-service: Timeout waiting for connection from pool [checkout-primary]
2026-08-24T09:13:45Z INFO  checkout-service: Retrying order submission, attempt 2/3
2026-08-24T09:14:10Z ERROR checkout-service: Order submission failed after 3 retries: connection pool exhausted

events.description: Rolled out checkout-service v2.14.0 (raised default query timeout, no pool size change)
Request rate 4.2x above 7-day baseline (flash sale campaign)
